name: Raleigh and the Undercity
summary: This quest bridges an investigation from Brill to the Undercity, tasking an adventurer with delivering a recovered heirloom ring to a widower named Raleigh. Found on the corpse of a Scourge defiler, the jewelry points to a tragedy among Lordaeron's former inhabitants. Delivering it sets into motion a dark pursuit of vengeance.

sections.title: A Tragic Heirloom
sections.body: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren pieced together clues surrounding a stolen corpse and recovered an engraved ring that once belonged to a woman named Deliah. Hoping to confirm its origin and see it returned to her family, Sevren directed the finder deep into the subterranean halls of the Undercity to seek Deliah's surviving husband, Raleigh.

sections.title: Cold Hearts, Bitter Vengeance
sections.body: Located in the bustling Trade Quarter of the Undercity, Raleigh Andrean recognizes his former wife's ring without hesitation. Like many of the Forsaken, undeath has withered his capacity for sorrow, grief, or remorse over Deliah's passing and desecration. However, where tender emotions have died away, an unyielding thirst for retribution remains, prompting Raleigh to plot revenge against those who violated her final rest.

aliases: where do i get raleigh and the undercity
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren starts this quest in the town of Brill within Tirisfal Glades, immediately after you return Deliah's Ring to him.
Raleigh Andrean is located in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity, standing among the subterranean city's merchants and craftsmen.
The ring belonged to Deliah, a woman from Brill who was Raleigh Andrean's wife prior to the fall of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why doesn't Raleigh mourn his dead wife?
faq.answer: As one of the Forsaken, Raleigh admits that tender emotions like grief and love have grown cold within his undead heart. Instead, his lingering passions have curdled into a cold desire for vengeance.
Handing in the ring leads directly into the quest 'A Husband's Revenge', where Raleigh sends you to avenge his wife's desecration.

faq.q: How was Deliah's ring found initially?
aliases: where did the ring come from
faq.answer: The ring was recovered during the quest 'The Engraved Ring', retrieved from the defiler who plundered Deliah's grave in Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: Raleigh's cold reaction to his wife's tragic demise reflects the widespread psychological trauma shared by the Forsaken, whose mortal attachments have decayed into bitter wrath.
Carrying tokens of old Lordaeron through the gates of the Undercity illustrates the somber realities of life among your Forsaken allies.
